fit.model: y_kj = g(v_k)(1 + drift tau_k)[Re W_j cos phi_k + Im W_j sin phi_k] + offset(v_k); phi free at each distinct v (phi(v_real) = 0); g = 1 + sum gain_n u^n; offset = sum offset_n u^n; u = v - v_real
fit.sign_note: The sign of the rotation is not observable from projections; phi is reported increasing with v. The complex lineshape fit fixes the sign.
fit.metric_note: Projections fix the reference direction only up to a 2x2 linear map. Angles here assume the detector gain is a low-order polynomial in v (gain_order). 0 and 180 deg (antiparallel) do not depend on that assumption; 90 deg does.
